entities.summary: Modupe Enitan Irele is a Nigerian diplomat and current Nigerian Ambassador to France, becoming the first female to hold the role since the diplomatic mission appointed its first representative in 1966. She was nominated by President Muhammadu Buhari on 20 October 2016, and presented her credentials to President Macron on 18 December 2017. She was appointed ambassador to Hungary in 2021.
